This is a very serious concern, signaling substantial profitability problems. Net income also decreased in comparison to the 2012 number, indicating a decline in the company's ability to generate profit.

The combination of declining revenue, significant profitability erosion, reduced cash reserves, and worsening key financial ratios, paints a concerning picture.
